notes: CBSA's inquire-accounts-for-customer service (INQACCCU, LINKed with the INQACCCU copybook's COMMAREA by BNK1CCA, CREACC and DELCUS). Its COMMAREA carries data after a POINTER (COMM-PCB-POINTER, then ACCOUNT-DETAILS OCCURS 1 TO 20 DEPENDING ON NUMBER-OF-ACCOUNTS): a POINTER is 4 bytes on z/OS and 8 under the oracle (oracle_assumptions.md C9), so each side's COMMAREA is read by its own layout and compared by name, the POINTER only as NULL. CUSTOMER-NUMBER zero or 9999999999 is not looked up; otherwise INQCUST is LINKed (run in the same task: READ FILE('CUSTOMER') by the program's own sort code, 987654) and, when it finds the customer, ACC-CURSOR is OPENed on the customer number and the program's own sort code (no ORDER BY: the order is Db2's, the same Db2 on both sides) and FETCHed into ACCOUNT-DETAILS until +100 or 20 accounts. A FETCH error (-305: a NULL date with no indicator) takes the program's failure path. The COMMAREA is compared whole (#4765): every account up to NUMBER-OF-ACCOUNTS, by name and subscript (COMM-ACC-TYPE(3)), each side's by its own count -- the det port's from the bytes it was LINKed with; ACCOUNT, CUSTOMER and ABNDFILE are compared after every scenario. Data: seed.sql and customer.txt are SYNTHETIC (customer.txt is cbsa-updcust's).
